summary_1line: Abandoned and grieving in the forest, Sita is discovered by Valmiki, who knows her purity and offers refuge in his hermitage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita stands weeping alone on the bank of the Ganges as Lakshmana’s departing chariot fades in the distance.
Young ascetic boys run through the forest hermitage to inform sage Valmiki about a mysterious woman crying by the river.
Valmiki, holding a ritual offering vessel, approaches the sorrowful Sita by the riverbank while disciples gather behind him.
